evidence: Touches transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp and adds test coverage in test/functional/wallet_fundrawtransaction.py, labeled Wallet.
rationale: Fixes a bug where caller-specified `max_tx_weight` was bypassed when preset inputs fully cover a payment amount. While this ensures wallet RPC options like `fundrawtransaction` honor caller limits, it is an edge-case parameter enforcement issue rather than a fund-safety or database-corruption hazard.
